name: North Carolina NCHSAA State Cross Country Championships
where: Kernersville, NC · Ivey Redmon Sports Complex
headline: North Carolina NCHSAA State Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: No. 10 Broughton won the 8A boys title with 19 points, ahead of Apex Friendship (98), and Broughton’s Tyler Burke won the race in 15:21.01. Green Level won the 8A girls title with 67 points to Panther Creek’s 75, and Hoggard’s Amelia Medlin won in 17:28.40.
